question: What is safe for me to spend this week?
title: Safe this week

cells.title: Safe to spend, this week and until payday
cells.code:
PENSION = (me.get("age") or 0) >= 68
PAY = "pension day" if PENSION else "payday"
PAY_TO = "pension day" if PENSION else "payday"
CYCLE = "pension cycle" if PENSION else "pay cycle"
def day(s):
    d = datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(s)[:10])
    return f"{d.day} {d:%b}"
emit("pay_word", PAY, "text", "The day money comes in")
emit("pay_to", PAY_TO, "text", "The day money comes in")

s = kori.safe_to_spend()
emit("this_week", s["this_week"], "eur", "Safe to spend this week")
emit("week_days", s["week_days"], "days", "Days counted in this week")
emit("per_day", s["per_day"], "eur_per_day", "Safe a day until payday")
emit("safe_to_spend", s["amount"], "eur", "Safe to spend until payday")
emit("days_to_payday", s["days_to_payday"], "days", "Days to payday")
emit("next_payday", s["next_payday"], "date", "Next payday")
emit("usual_per_day", s["usual_per_day"], "eur_per_day", "Your usual day")
emit("status_line", s["status_line"], "text", "How the pace looks")
if s["amount"] > 0 and s["this_week"] > 0:        # nothing safe to spend: no kept answer, the question is worked out fresh
    say(f"This week **{eur(s['this_week'], True)}** is safe to spend: {eur(s['per_day'], True)} a day for {s['week_days']} days, the pace that lasts until {PAY} on {day(s['next_payday'])}.")
